description:
Use this when you need an auditable Ghana working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide statutory/public-holiday layer only. It is not a universal private-employer, bank, exchange, school, local, sector or essential-service calendar. The 2026 package uses observed dates published or cross-checked for 2026; lunar dates and later Executive Instruments may change. It does not treat the pre-Act-1142 4 August Founder’s Day or 2025-era September naming as current law, and it does not infer additional closure days from the legal anchors alone.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Ghana working days around Republic Day observed. | Count Ghana working days around Ordinary Ghana working day.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-03-20","end_date":"2026-03-23","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/ghana-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/ghana-public-working-days-between.md
name: count_gh_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Ghana 2026 nationwide statutory/public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday weekend

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Ghana Working Days
